name: UV-mapped Instanced Point Cloud/Voxel Rendering
definition: Renders large point clouds or voxel grids by creating a single instancer mesh of pseudo-faces (three vertices at identical 3D coordinates per point), mapping each point to a 2D color texture atlas via UV coordinates, and using Blender's face-based object instancing to duplicate a particle mesh at each position with per-instance colors.
summary: UV-mapped Instanced Point Cloud/Voxel Rendering renders large datasets by mapping per-instance colors to a 2D texture atlas, optimizing memory bandwidth and enabling high instance counts on hardware with limited attribute support.
